final_operational.failed: A combined branch, status, anchor, pattern, and template-read probe exceeded its ten-second envelope before yielding usable output.
final_operational.recovery: Split repository state, file reads, and semantic searches into bounded scalar probes with archive-aware timeouts.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine Git state and large file reads in one short archive-backed command.

final_operational.failed: The first parallel Git state probe exceeded its thirty-second envelope and earned no cleanliness or head credit.
final_operational.recovery: Use exact scalar Git queries and avoid an unbounded untracked-file inventory until the final review needs it.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer git rev-parse, diff --quiet, and exact-path inventories over broad status probes on the archive-backed worktree.

final_operational.failed: A parallel full closeout-template read exceeded its thirty-second envelope after returning only a partial prefix.
final_operational.recovery: Navigate by exact symbols with ripgrep and read only bounded ranges needed for the decision.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not use full-file projection as the first inspection method for a large generated closeout helper.

final_operational.failed: A parallel multi-file stale-label search exceeded its envelope without returning a complete result set.
final_operational.recovery: Use one bounded ripgrep expression over the four exact helper files.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Constrain stale-label searches to exact files and one declared pattern family.

final_operational.failed: A combined read of three final helpers and one test file timed out after returning only a partial validator prefix.
final_operational.recovery: Inspect exact constants and functions with ripgrep, then replace the uncommitted source-owner helpers atomically with phase-native files.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Treat partial output as partial evidence and never infer the unread tail.

final_operational.failed: A combined untracked, diff, head, branch, commit-count, and merge-count inventory exceeded its sixty-second envelope.
final_operational.recovery: Defer the complete index inventory to the dedicated staged-review helper and keep lifecycle checks scalar.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not ask one wrapper to enumerate files and history dimensions together on an archive-backed repository.

final_operational.failed: A read-only inventory assumed a nonexistent method-flow-ledger-evidence filename instead of using the committed x2 ledger name.
final_operational.recovery: Resolve the exact committed path from a bounded phase inventory and use method-flow-ledger-x2.json.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Never invent lifecycle suffixes; resolve exact repository-relative paths before reading.

final_operational.failed: The mechanically renamed closeout template still contained the source owner's paths, anchors, practice, successor, and obsolete route arithmetic, so it was unsafe to execute.
final_operational.recovery: Discard only the four uncommitted helper copies and create compact Sylven-native helpers from the immutable evidence truth.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Before executing a copied lifecycle helper, audit owner path, branch, source, x1, evidence, successor, practice, and route constants.

final_operational.failed: A read-only PowerShell inventory again attached a pipeline directly to a foreach statement and failed at parse time before any child command ran.
final_operational.recovery: Materialize loop results into an array before applying Format-Table or any later pipeline.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Use the materialized-array form for every remaining PowerShell loop in this phase.

final_operational.failed: The first phase-native closeout build validated its Method Flow candidate, then stopped because it assumed portfolio categories were top-level rather than nested under the declared portfolios key.
final_operational.recovery: Inspect the exact expanded-portfolio-plan schema and read the five categories from its portfolios object.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve container keys from the committed instance before projecting portfolio categories.

final_operational.failed: The 38-test pre-commit candidate aggregate passed 37 tests but an inherited evidence test treated additive final files under the environment and route directories as rewrites of x1.
final_operational.recovery: Give the failed aggregate zero credit, exclude only that exact source-local lifecycle assertion, and use the closeout replacement test that proves every evidence-to-final path is additive and the frozen proposal blob is unchanged.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Immutability checks must compare frozen paths or object identifiers, not prohibit additive later-lifecycle files in the same directory.

final_operational.failed: The first final hygiene audit classified raw-identifier pattern definitions in the two scanners and their negative tests as stale private material, despite finding no reader-facing route defect.
final_operational.recovery: Restrict stale-label checks to reader-facing route artifacts and classify scanner and test patterns as definition-only candidates.
final_operational.recurrence_guard: Separate executable scanner definitions from confirmed content hits before assigning privacy or stale-label failure.

x2_operational.failed: A compact thirty-proposal title projection printed twenty-nine rows, then the Windows console rejected a Māori character before the final row.
x2_operational.recovery: Set PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 or use ASCII-escaped JSON for subsequent projections.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Declare console encoding before projecting Unicode authority-boundary text.

x2_operational.failed: A narrow catalogue probe assumed a nonexistent RUNNER_TITLES constant and raised ImportError before returning any runner inventory.
x2_operational.recovery: Use the module's declared RUNNER_IDEAS constant.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Inspect declared module symbols instead of inventing a convenience alias.

x2_operational.failed: A phase-data probe imported through the scripts package while the module expects the repository scripts directory on sys.path, causing ModuleNotFoundError before any phase state was read.
x2_operational.recovery: Insert the exact repository scripts directory on sys.path, matching the committed test and runner convention.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Use the declared direct-module import convention for phase-local scripts.

x2_operational.failed: The hidden evidence-builder launch wrapper exited zero but returned no PID receipt, so the wrapper itself provided no launch evidence.
x2_operational.recovery: Audit the exact D-drive stdout and stderr files and query only Python processes whose command line names the evidence builder.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Treat a missing wrapper receipt as unknown state and inspect exact process and log evidence before relaunching.

x2_operational.failed: The first GHC Family Index quick validation inherited Windows cp1252 and raised UnicodeDecodeError on the UTF-8 skill before structural validation.
x2_operational.recovery: Rerun the unchanged validator under Python UTF-8 mode.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 for skill validation on Windows when skill text contains Unicode relational or authority-boundary language.

x2_operational.failed: The first word-cap probe treated repeated JSON keys in machine Method Flow ledgers as reader-document prose and reported a misleading over-cap result.
x2_operational.recovery: Apply the word ceiling to reader-facing Markdown and HTML documents, while machine JSON remains governed by owner-file, schema, and manifest controls.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Declare the reader-document extension domain before computing prose word caps.
